title: Bench graders read the main tree after a worktree build
what: Scenario graders that read files find the change where relay's rules put it: either the scenario's prompt says the change is merged when done, or the grader reads the newest task branch (git show <branch>:path) when the main tree lacks it. Check every scenario under evals/scenarios for the same shape.
why: Bench 2026-10-30T02-38-10Z, scenario add-function, profile judge-fable run 1: the session succeeded (worker, critic, fixer, checker ran; 14 turns, $1.51), the worker built removeItem on branch wt/remove-item in .worktrees/remove-item and left the merge to the owner, as relay's rules say; the graders grep src/shelf.ts in the main tree and failed. The score fell 0.20 for a reason unrelated to the setup under test, and nearly blocked the owner's Fable decision.
failing_case: ~/.relay/bench/2026-10-30T02-38-10Z: judge-fable add-function run 1 failed function-exists and test-written (grep -q 'export function removeItem' src/shelf.ts in the main tree, exit 1) while the function existed on wt/remove-item at ac97752.
pass_cases: A replay of that run's workspace with the change only on a task branch passes function-exists and test-written.
A run with no function anywhere still fails them.
